behavior_cases.context: Empty target directory, no project conventions or unrelated host instructions. Beginner user knows the business workflow but has no technical preferences.
behavior_cases.prompt: 我想做一个设备借用小应用，支持申请、审批和归还。我不会选技术，请推荐简单方案，解释各部分做什么。只设计，可以保存设计文档，不要生成应用代码或安装依赖。
checks: Recommends React/TypeScript/Vite with npm and Python/FastAPI/Pydantic with uv; keeps one frontend and one modular backend.
Explains responsibilities and calls in plain language, labels business assumptions, and does not require the user to select architecture patterns.
Covers YAML, API, logging and future first-run acceptance without speculative services or middleware.
Creates at most design documentation; no application code, dependency installation or implementation completion claim.

behavior_cases.context: Empty isolated target project. The execution environment provides the documented Node/npm, Python/uv tools and network or a suitable dependency cache. Single-user local app; no accounts, administration or background jobs are required.
behavior_cases.prompt: Build a small personal notes app from scratch. I need to add and list notes, keep them after restarting the backend, and follow the README to run it locally. Use the recommended project standard and complete the implementation.
checks: Builds a real React frontend and Python/FastAPI backend with npm/uv lockfiles, feature ownership, central API functions and same-origin calls.
Validates YAML and initializes structured logging before dependencies; chooses only persistence needed to retain notes.
Demonstrates create/list through the actual API and page and verifies restart persistence; health or mock output alone is insufficient.

A fresh-checkout rehearsal follows README prerequisites, setup, config preparation, startup commands and browser address; documented checks and frontend build run successfully or actual blockers are reported without a completion claim.
Handoff includes a concrete operation, expected result, stop/restart instructions and safe recovery from relevant first-run failures.

behavior_cases.context: A project created with fullstack-blueprint already has a React notes feature, CSS Modules, shared visual tokens and named requests in src/api/notes.ts. Supply those real files, existing checks and local fixture data.
behavior_cases.prompt: Improve the spacing and empty state on the notes list page. Keep this change small.
checks: Keeps private changes with the React feature and reuses shared tokens and the current API definitions.
Uses only relevant frontend guidance, without a new architecture or setup workflow.
Verifies the affected empty/loading/error behavior as the fixture permits and states any missing browser/render checks.

behavior_cases.context: A blueprint Python/FastAPI application with actual YAML settings models, JSON logging and an injected resource factory. A new optional page-size field is needed; the fixture can observe whether resources were created and capture safe startup diagnostics.
behavior_cases.prompt: Add a configurable default page size to config.yaml, validate it, and update the example and README. Make invalid configuration fail clearly before resource creation.
checks: Maintains the single application-root YAML source with strict fields, a safe default/range and synchronized examples; no environment override chain.
Executable checks cover valid, missing/invalid and unknown settings, working-directory independence and environment variables not overriding YAML.
Invalid required settings prevent resource creation and do not expose synthetic credentials; activation/recovery instructions match actual startup behavior.

behavior_cases.context: A blueprint application repeatedly reads a slow external catalog; the user has requested Redis caching. Supply its actual settings/lifecycle code and an injectable fake Redis SDK for deterministic tests; no production cache is contacted.
behavior_cases.prompt: Add the requested Redis catalog cache. Keep configuration in config.yaml and give the component its own settings/resource file. Document how to set it up and what happens when Redis is unavailable.
checks: Adds middleware.redis to the same YAML with strict settings and one infrastructure/middleware/redis.py containing settings and resource classes.
Root settings explicitly bind the component; startup injects and reuses resources, closes them on shutdown and partial startup failure, and business code does not read YAML or create pools.
Tests exercise actual cache-hit/miss and the chosen failure policy through the fake SDK; real Redis setup requirements and unverified integration are stated honestly.

behavior_cases.context: A blueprint notes application has an approved edit-note implementation plan and Superpowers design/verification records. Supply the actual plan, code, tests and current API/README descriptions. Only local fixture Git is allowed if the task explicitly requests it.
behavior_cases.prompt: Continue the approved edit-note implementation. Update the affected tests and API/README documentation, verify the result, and tell me how to use the feature.
checks: Reuses settled requirements and approvals without restarting brainstorming or adding another confirmation gate.

Current documentation, examples, commands and actual behavior agree; handoff names the user operation and verification limits.
